analysis: The change applies String.prototype.trim() to the supplied name before interpolating it into the unchanged greeting. For the contracted string inputs, this removes leading and trailing whitespace while preserving internal whitespace and the existing greeting punctuation. Empty or entirely whitespace names produce the existing greeting prefix with an empty name; no default or validation was requested. Non-string inputs could now throw where interpolation previously coerced them, but those inputs are explicitly outside the contract, so this is not a supported-input regression. No behavioral defect was identified.
